tower.play: Two open ground approaches, stair refuge, broken upper decks and an exposed roof.

hotel.play: Room partitions beside a common corridor, balconies and roof shelter.

apartment.play: Small defensible rooms open to a traversable common stair.

house.play: A small room, front porch, breached rear and a broken stepped roof.

mall.play: Shops flank an open central court; upper galleries expose crossing survivors.

shop.play: Open storefronts and a repeating canopy along the public edge.

shed.play: Long clear aisles, loading doors and roof fragments on structural frames.

garage.play: Open decks with low cover and a stair in place of a tilted vehicle ramp.

marina.play: A low quay shelter and exposed walkways; no invented seawall through open water.

station.play: An open lower passage and elevated waiting deck.

bridge.play: Existing causeway alignment gets parapet remnants. Authored water gaps stay open.

park.play: Sparse benches and a low gathering plinth, leaving paths and vegetation open.

monument.play: A visible stepped marker with cover at its foot.

civic.play: A public colonnade, assembly room and protected upper refuge.

theatre.play: An open auditorium and raised stage watched from upper galleries.

arena.play: Open arena floor surrounded by stepped seating, concourse and broken roof rim.

hall.play: Very long hall sightlines interrupted by columns and debris islands.

school.play: Classroom wings and an open court with several approaches.

hospital.play: Wards and a broad entry canopy; corridors connect protected stair landings.

service.play: Large apparatus bays below a defended office gallery and observation stub.

utility.play: Tank remnants and service yards with narrow approaches.

fabric.play: Unknown use: modest open shell and one climbable refuge, never a speculative landmark.
